title: Anyone link on a sensitive site
summary: An attacker creates an Anyone link on a sensitive SharePoint site so files can be downloaded without signing in.

steps.title: Starting assumption
steps.text: The attacker controls an account with access to a sensitive site and wants to move data out with as little friction as possible.

steps.title: Anyone link created
steps.text: The attacker creates an Anyone link that grants access to files without any sign-in. The link can be shared or sold freely.
steps.whenFixed: Anonymous sharing is disabled, so no Anyone link can be created, and the attempt is recorded.

steps.title: Files downloaded through the link
steps.text: Anyone holding the link downloads the files without authenticating. There is no record of who took the data.
steps.whenFixed: A short expiry on Anyone links narrows the window in which the link works.

outcome.prevented: Anonymous sharing is refused, so a no-sign-in link is never created.
outcome.notPrevented: Sensitive files are downloadable by anyone who receives the link.
